# A diagnostic over perl 5.42's lib that perl itself warns or dies on, and so
# is admitted beyond lib_baseline.txt: the privlib-relative diagnostic, a tab,
# and the line perl -w prints calling into the real lib file's own code (not
# a `-e`/minimal-repro script reimplementing the construct inline), copied
# verbatim.
#
# issue 01a156e4 (narrow undef after ref/defined/blessed guards) removed the
# entries the narrowing now sees through: a `ref($x)` truthy guard (plain,
# `&&` short-circuit, `unless ... return`, an if/elsif chain whose earlier
# branch consumes the falsy value), the same for a named array's
# literal-index element and for $_, a dominating arrow deref of the
# argument (vars.go's narrowDerefBase), reftype/refaddr/encode/qualify
# declared as multis by argument type, and types.Select's own Unknown
# bypass and coercion retry (select.go) no longer discarding an argument
# that already decides the call just because another argument does not.
#
# perigrin's ruling (2026-10-20) widened --warn-possible-undef's default
# silence to a Selected call through a multi's widest, catch-all candidate
# (not only types.Select's own Undecided join) whenever the argument's own
# type still overlaps a narrower, Undef-free sibling's -- reftype, refaddr
# and blessed given an argument never proven a Ref, among others. This
# removed every remaining reftype/refaddr call site below it reached
# (Safe.pm:424, Term/Table.pm:103, Test/Builder.pm:349, three
# Math/BigInt.pm lines, and six more across Test2::*): each is reported
# only under the flag now, not by default, so none is a lib_baseline.txt
# entry any more.
#
# Auditing what's left (2026-10-20) found twelve more lines whose only
# evidence was a `-e`/minimal-repro script, not the real lib code path --
# re-measured directly against the installed modules, driving the real
# sub or method rather than reimplementing the construct. Twelve of those
# could not be reproduced at the real path at all: each, on inspection,
# is unreachable by ordinary perl semantics (a guard the construct's own
# code already establishes, just not one psc's narrowing recognizes), not
# evidence the undef is real:
#   - File/Temp.pm:916 and :1147: Cwd::abs_path on a directory `-d` already
#     proved to exist; only a TOCTOU race (removed between the two calls)
#     makes it fail, not forceable from a single-threaded script.
#   - Test/Builder.pm:207, :259: `bless {...}, blessed($self)` is reached
#     only via `$self->ctx`, a method call that requires $self already
#     blessed -- blessed($self) cannot then be undef.
#   - Test/Builder.pm:372, Test2/API.pm:722: `blessed($err) && blessed($err)
#     eq '...'` -- the `&&` already proved the left blessed($err) truthy
#     before the same call's second evaluation is compared.
#   - Test2/IPC/Driver/Files.pm:71: `$type->isa(...)` two lines above dies
#     outright on an undef $type, so split never sees one.
#   - Test2/Util/Ref.pm:21: reached only once `$rf || $rt` holds; ref($thing)
#     truthy implies $thing is a reference, and reftype of any reference is
#     never undef, so $rt cannot be undef there.
#   - Test2/Workflow/Task.pm:133 (both operands): reached only after
#     `$lines && @$lines`, which proves List::Util::max/min's argument list
#     non-empty, so neither returns its empty-list Undef.
#   - Sys/Syslog.pm:562: `print`'s declared Boolean|Undef is sound (measured:
#     printing to a filehandle closed out from under it does return undef),
#     but forcing that failure needs a real console device fault, not
#     reachable from a script.
#   - Test2/Workflow.pm:111: $events is Test2::API::intercept's own
#     collected event list, populated only with genuine Test2::Event
#     objects by the hub, not user data; not reachable from outside.
# Each of these would need its own new narrowing (a method call proving
# its invocant blessed, a repeated call's second evaluation reusing the
# first's proof, an array's own non-emptiness proving List::Util's return,
# or similar) -- a different, broader mechanism per site, not this
# ticket's ref/defined/blessed-guard or catch-all-candidate narrowing, so
# none is implemented here; each is left unaccounted rather than kept with
# invented evidence.
